automation_evidence.quote: T IME RSI automates two deployment decisions: how to improve a task-specific pipeline and which pipeline to use for a new forecast.

metric_evidence.quote: Main results. T IME RSI achieves the best scores on both benchmarks across all six reported metrics (Fig. 2).

evidence.quote: Adaptive Pipeline Selection A pipeline that performs well on average may not be the best choice

practical_problems.note: similarity-based selector targets changing forecast conditions, but no ablation of the selector or shift test is reported; limitations name distribution shift as open

evidence.quote: The evaluator supplies the same chronological windows to all candidates. Candidate code receives no target values beyond each window’s origin.

practical_problems.note: leakage-safe protocol, not an experiment that varies availability

summary: TimeRSI automates pipeline code revision and per-forecast selection around frozen TSFMs and ranks first on TIME and FEV-bench; a feedback-revision ablation supports the loop, but the shift-targeting selector is not isolated.
